Basketball and hockey scale by expected minutes, which you can override for injuries or blowouts. Adjusts for the opponent: points allowed, opponent misses and pace (NBA), pass/run defense (NFL). Turns the projection into an over/under probability using the player's own game-to-game variance, then blends it with the actual hit rate. Compares that to the sportsbook price to get edge and expected value. A–C grades need a real edge; anything smaller says PASS.
